bio: Dosoji worshipped his teacher – the man had taken Dosoji off the streets as a child, and showed him how to live and fight with honor. He refused to believe the dark rumors that began to circle… but the attack that followed could not be denied. His master is gone, and Dosoji must redeem his name.
